name: pnpm Store (workspace-aware)
description: Configures a shared pnpm content-addressable store on the SAME filesystem as your code, so pnpm's hardlinks work and no stray .pnpm-store folders pollute your repos. A safer alternative to Docker-volume-based pnpm store sharing, which breaks hardlinking in bind-mounted workspaces.

storeDir.description: Absolute path of the pnpm store. Must live on the SAME filesystem as your repos (e.g. a host folder bind-mounted next to them). Defaults to /workspaces/.pnpm-store.

setGlobalConfig.description: Write 'store-dir=<storeDir>' into the remote user's ~/.npmrc so pnpm uses the shared store globally.

failIfCrossDevice.description: Fail container creation if the store is on a different filesystem than one of the repos. Prevents pnpm from silently creating a .pnpm-store inside each repo. Defaults to false (warn only); set to true for strict enforcement once the bind-mount is in place.

checkAgainst.description: Directory whose immediate subdirectories are checked to be on the same filesystem as the store. Set to a single repo path to narrow the check.
